faq.heading: Common questions
faq.a1: Yes. You can move up to a higher plan any time while your current plan is active. The new plan starts fresh from the day you upgrade.
faq.a2: All payments run through Razorpay over SSL. We never see or store your card details.
faq.a3: Each unlock reveals a member’s phone number so your families can talk directly.
faq.a3Cap: Each unlock reveals a member’s phone number so your families can talk directly. Unlimited-tier plans are capped at {{cap}} unlocks a day, to keep the directory safe from bulk scraping.
faq.a4: Upgrading starts a full fresh term on the new plan; remaining days on the old plan are not added on top.
faq.q5: Can my parents manage this account?
faq.a5: Yes. The Guardian feature lets a family member view matches and shortlists for you.
